title: Testing React components
summary: Add Vitest and Testing Library to a React project, or confirm the Capstone starter has them, and write the three kinds of test the Capstone needs: a render test, a test that types and clicks like a user, and a test of a request that fails. You will see each test fail for the right reason before it passes, and learn which tests a change to the code affects.
